description: One of a host's access rules set (capability: the rule's name), or a chat's own rule for managing it (session; capability manage_read or manage_write; rule null: the host's again). Refused (access_denied) from a member the access_write rule doesn't allow.

req.description: The request's number, the client's pick: its answers carry it back.

capability.description: The rule's name (AccessRules'): a chat's, manage_read or manage_write.

session.description: A chat of the host's: its own rule.

rule.description: The rule (null, for a chat: the host's).
